60082-the-stock-exchange-from-within.title: From Within
60082-the-stock-exchange-from-within.creator: W. C. Van Antwerp
60082-the-stock-exchange-from-within.description: A book by W. C. Van Antwerp. The study of any form of economic development, like the study of sciences and philosophies, requires infinite patience. But the “man in the street” is bored to death by such methods; he wants to take a short cut to his conclusions; merely tasting the Pierian spring he hurries on to judgments that are superficial, haphazard, and often crude and blundering.

arxiv-2203-06250.title: Combining imitation and deep reinforcement learning to human-level performance on a virtual foraging task
arxiv-2203-06250.creator: Vittorio Giammarino, Matthew F Dunne, Kylie N Moore, Michael E Hasselmo, Chantal E Stern, Ioannis Ch. Paschalidis
arxiv-2203-06250.description: Abstract We develop a simple framework to learn bio-inspired foraging policies using human data. We conduct an experiment where humans are virtually immersed in an open field foraging environment and are trained to collect the highest amount of rewards. A Markov Decision Process (MDP) framework is introduced to model the human decision dynamics.

arxiv-2209-09305.title: A Double-Layered Water Cherenkov Detector Array for Gamma-Ray Astronomy Journal: Nucl. Instr. Meth. Phys. Res.
arxiv-2209-09305.creator: Samridha Kunwar, Hazal Goksu, Jim Hinton, Harm Schoorlemmer, Andrew Smith, Werner Hofmann, Felix Werner
arxiv-2209-09305.description: Abstract Ground-level particle detection is now a well-established approach to TeV γ \gamma -ray astronomy. Detection of Cherenkov light produced in water-filled detection units is a proven and cost-effective method. Here we discuss the optimization of the units towards the future Southern Wide-field Gamma-ray Observatory (SWGO).

arxiv-2506-15285.title: AI-driven visual monitoring of industrial assembly tasks
arxiv-2506-15285.creator: Mattia Nardon, Stefano Messelodi, Antonio Granata, Fabio Poiesi, Alberto Danese, Davide Boscaini
arxiv-2506-15285.description: Abstract Visual monitoring of industrial assembly tasks is critical for preventing equipment damage due to procedural errors and ensuring worker safety. Although commercial solutions exist, they typically require rigid workspace setups or the application of visual markers to simplify the problem. We introduce ViMAT, a novel AI-driven system for real-time visual monitoring of assembly tasks that operates without these constraints.

britannica-1911-gmund.title: Gmünd (1911 Encyclopaedia Britannica article)
britannica-1911-gmund.creator: Encyclopaedia Britannica
britannica-1911-gmund.description: Article 'Gmünd' from the 1911 Encyclopædia Britannica (Volume 12), the classic English-language general encyclopedia, now in the public domain. Gmünd was surrounded by walls in the beginning of the 12th century by Duke Frederick of Swabia. It received town rights from Frederick Barbarossa, and after the extinction of the Hohenstaufen became a free imperial town. It retained its independence till 1803, when it came into the possession of Württemberg. pmc-10564238.title: Genome-based metabolic and phylogenomic analysis of three Terrisporobacter species
pmc-10564238.creator: Tim Böer, Frank R. Bengelsdorf, Mechthild Bömeke, Rolf Daniel, Anja Poehlein
pmc-10564238.description: Acetogenic bacteria are of high interest for biotechnological applications as industrial platform organisms, however, acetogenic strains from the genus Terrisporobacter have hitherto been neglected. To date, three published type strains of the genus Terrisporobacter are only covered by draft genome sequences, and the genes and pathway responsible for acetogenesis have not been analyzed.

pmc-10839064.title: Benefits Trafficking: human trafficking of older adults and adults with disabilities
pmc-10839064.creator: Anna Thomas, Heather Strickland
pmc-10839064.description: An emerging type of trafficking is targeting overlooked at-risk adults. Benefits Trafficking is the systematic recruitment, harboring, neglect, and financial exploitation of elder and disabled adults who receive government benefits such as Social Security, Veteran's Benefits, Medicaid, and Medicare. Traffickers often pose as kind-hearted individuals offering to provide care for at-risk adults in an in-home setting.

pmc-11329515.title: Moving spiders do not boost visual search in spider fear
pmc-11329515.creator: Miriam Becker, Nikolaus F. Troje, Filipp Schmidt, Anke Haberkamp
pmc-11329515.description: Previous research on attention to fear-relevant stimuli has largely focused on static pictures or drawings, and thus did not consider the potential effect of natural motion. Here, we aimed to investigate the effect of motion on attentional capture in spider-fearful and non-fearful participants by using point-light stimuli and naturalistic videos.

pmc-11434268.title: The Effects of Maternal Nutrient Restriction during Mid to Late Gestation with Realimentation on Fetal Metabolic Profiles in the Liver, Skeletal Muscle, and Blood in Sheep
pmc-11434268.creator: Brandon I. Smith, Manuel A. Vásquez-Hidalgo, Xiaomeng Li, Kimberly A. Vonnahme, Anna T. Grazul-Bilska, Kendall C. Swanson, Timothy E. Moore, Sarah A. Reed, Kristen E. Govoni
pmc-11434268.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Poor maternal nutrition during gestation negatively affects offspring growth and metabolism. To evaluate the impact of maternal nutrient restriction and realimentation on metabolism in the fetal liver, skeletal muscle, and circulation, on day 50 of gestation, ewes (n = 48) pregnant with singletons were fed 100% (CON) or 60% (RES) of requirements until day 90 of gestation, when a subset of ewes (n = 7/treatment) were euthanized, and fetal samples were collected.

pmc-11508981.title: Progress in the Stereoselective Synthesis Methods of Pyrrolidine-Containing Drugs and Their Precursors
pmc-11508981.creator: Andrey Smolobochkin, Almir Gazizov, Nurbol Appazov, Oleg Sinyashin, Alexander Burilov, Jan Korabecny, Debasish Bandyopadhyay
pmc-11508981.description: The presented review systematizes and summarizes the data on the synthesis of pyrrolidine derivatives, which are precursors for obtaining drugs. Based on the analysis of published data, the most promising directions in the synthesis of biologically active compounds containing a pyrrolidine ring are identified. Stereoselective synthesis methods are classified based on the source of the pyrrolidine ring.

pmc-11665747.title: Impact of type 2 diabetes mellitus on the prevalence of apical periodontitis in endodontically treated and untreated teeth
pmc-11665747.creator: Andreea Marica, Razvan Chirla, Mihai Porumb, Lucian Roman Sipos, Raluca Ortensia Cristina Iurcov, Simona Cavalu
pmc-11665747.description: Apical periodontitis (AP) is a common dental condition that can be influenced by diabetes mellitus. This study aimed to investigate the impact of type 2 diabetes mellitus (T2DM) on the prevalence and severity of AP, considering the adequacy of endodontic treatments.

pmc-12471365.title: Evaluation of a Non-Stagnant Water Gap in Hollow-Fiber Membrane Distillation and Multistage Performance Limitations
pmc-12471365.creator: Mohamed O. Elbessomy, Kareem W. Farghaly, Osama A. Elsamni, Samy M. Elsherbiny, Ahmed Rezk, Mahmoud B. Elsheniti
pmc-12471365.description: Hollow-fiber water gap membrane distillation (HF-WGMD) modules are gaining attention for desalination applications due to their compact design and high surface-area-to-volume ratio. This study presents a comprehensive CFD model to analyze and compare the performance of two HF-WGMD module configurations: one with a conventional stagnant water gap (WG) and the other incorporating water gap flow circulation.

pmc-12526300.title: A Novel Polyacrylamide Film-Forming Agent for Maintaining Wellbore Stability
pmc-12526300.creator: Guoyan Ma, Wenjing Wei, Yanzhe Yang, Chao Hao, Yaru Zhang, Guoqiang Xu, Dimitrios Bikiaris
pmc-12526300.description: A polyacrylamide-based film-forming agent was synthesized via free-radical copolymerization. FT-IR spectroscopy confirmed complete monomer conversion with no detectable residual unsaturation. Systematic variation of acrylamide (AM), vinyl acetate (VAc) and cellulose content revealed that an AM mass fraction of 3.7 wt%, a VAc:AM molar ratio of 1:3 and a cellulose content of 1.6 wt% yielded an emulsion of maximal colloidal stability.

pmc-12567040.title: Comparison of Two Measurement Methods for Scattering and Absorption Coefficients in Boron Carbide Nanodispersions
pmc-12567040.creator: Luca Mercatelli, Maria Raffaella Martina, Javier P Vallejo, Luis Lugo, Elisa Sani, Mingjie Li
pmc-12567040.description: Nanoparticles suspended in a liquid alter the properties of the base liquid, expanding its fields of application. Nanodispersions can have several applications in solar energy, including serving as liquid sunlight absorbers, acting as optical filters in optics, or functioning as heat transfer fluids in solar thermal applications.

pmc-12712204.title: Feline vitamin D-dependent rickets type 2 caused by a missense variant in the vitamin D receptor gene
pmc-12712204.creator: Sora SUZUKI, Hitomi MASUYAMA, Jiro MIYAMAE, Hiroaki HEMMI, Naoaki MATSUKI, Kohei MURAKAMI
pmc-12712204.description: An 11-month-old female kitten was evaluated for lameness and an inability to close her mouth. The kitten had marked hypocalcemia with elevated intact parathyroid hormone and 1,25(OH)2D3 levels. Radiographic imaging indicated generalized osteopenia and dysplasia of temporomandibular joints. Since a nutritionally complete diet was being fed, dysfunction of vitamin D receptors (VDR) was suspected. Genetic tests revealed three variants (c.

pmc-12731966.title: APACHE II and NUTRIC Scores for Mortality Prediction in Chronic Critical Illness: A “Right-Side” Prognostic Modeling Approach
pmc-12731966.creator: Dmitrij V Zhidilyaev, Levan B Berikashvili, Mikhail Ya Yadgarov, Petr A Polyakov, Alexey A Yakovlev, Artem N Kuzovlev, Valery V Likhvantsev, Zhongheng Zhang
pmc-12731966.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Background/Objectives: Accurate prognostication for patients with chronic critical illness (CCI) following brain injury remains challenging. Conventional scoring systems like the Acute Physiology and Chronic Health Evaluation II (APACHE II) and the Nutrition Risk in the Critically Ill (NUTRIC) score are validated as “left-side” models for risk stratification at intensive care unit (ICU) admission but may not capture the evolving trajectory of prolonged illness.

pmc-12841322.title: A Vignette-Based Measure of Mental Health Literacy (PDR-V): Reliability, Validity, and Mindfulness Associations in a Cross-Sectional Sample
pmc-12841322.creator: Matea Gerbeza, Saba Salimuddin, Jenna Kazeil, Shadi Beshai
pmc-12841322.description: Psychological distress impacts a large portion of the general population. While effective treatments are available, few seek them out. This lack of treatment seeking may be due to several factors, particularly low mental health literacy (MHL). MHL is the knowledge an individual has regarding psychological disorders and their symptoms, treatments, and where to seek appropriate help when identified.

pmc-13025686.title: A Channel-Independent Anchor Graph-Regularized Broad Learning System for Industrial Soft Sensors
pmc-13025686.creator: Zhiyi Zhang, Mingyi Yang, Cheng Xie, Zhigang Xu, Pengfei Yin
pmc-13025686.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). To address the nonlinear dynamics and strong multivariate coupling inherent in complex industrial data, while overcoming the high computational costs and deployment challenges of deep learning, this paper proposes a Channel-Independent Anchor Graph-Regularized Broad Learning System (CI-GBLS). First, a Channel Independence (CI) strategy is introduced: by constructing physically isolated feature channels, multivariate inputs are orthogonally decomposed, enabling the model to mine the intrinsic temporal evolutionary patterns of each variable.

pmc-13234930.title: Unveiling the antioxidant and anti-epileptic potential of Castanea sativa against pentylenetetrazole in mice: a comparative LC-MS analysis of two ethanol-based fractions
pmc-13234930.creator: Abeer Salama, Rasha M. M. Mohasib, Hagar H. Mourad, Nesrine M. Hegazi, Tarik A. Mohamed, Mohamed-Elamir F. Hegazy
pmc-13234930.description: Epilepsy is a chronic neurological disorder in which oxidative stress and neuroinflammation play key pathogenic roles. There is growing interest in natural antioxidants with neuroprotective properties as complementary therapies. Castanea sativa (C. sativa) fruits, rich in phenolic acids and flavonoids, may offer such potential.

pmc-13239704.title: Prenatal and child malaria and child growth: evidence from a Ghanaian pregnancy cohort
pmc-13239704.creator: Olufunke Sowole, Seyram Kaali, Michelle Li, Mohammed Mujtaba, Blair J Wylie, Stephaney Gyaase, Steven Chillrud, Oscar Agyei, Darby Jack, Alison Lee, Kwaku Poku Asante
pmc-13239704.description: IntroductionAdditional investigation is needed to better understand the associations between prenatal and early child malaria and early childhood growth outcomes.MethodsWe leveraged the Ghana Randomized Air Pollution and Health Study which enrolled 1414 pregnant women from Kintampo, Ghana, and followed the mother-child dyads through the child’s first year of life. We defined prenatal malaria exposure by histopathological examination of placenta tissue.

uslaw-usc-t33-s3851.title: 33 U.S.C. § 3851 — Criminal enforcement
uslaw-usc-t33-s3851.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t33-s3851.description: United States Code, Title 33 (Navigation And Navigable Waters); Chapter 51 (Clean Hulls); Subchapter IV (Action On Violation, Penalties, And Referrals). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. Any person who knowingly violates paragraph (2), (3), (4), or (5) of section 3841(a) of this title or section 3841(b) of this title shall be fined under title 18 or imprisoned not more than 6 years.
